row.notes: Clamps max_dist (xmm2) to 0..5000 (0x459c4000); 0 -> returns 0. Uses x = max(v0, v1). Visits the 2x2x2 corners of table_a (strides +0x160..+0x188, cursor_a indices +0x20..+0x68, bracket +0x40/+0x48) and, per corner, cells of table_b (strides +0x190..+0x1b0, cursor_b brackets +0x28/+0x30, +0x38/+0x40, +0x48/+0x50); each cell is a curve searched via vtbl +8/+0x10 and evaluated at v0 and v1, difference f(v0)-f(v1) capped by max_dist with a 10-step iteration. Corners are blended multi-linearly with keys cursor_b+4 (axis +0xb8), +8 (axis +0xe8), +0xc (axis +0x118) and cursor_a+0x10 (axis +0xd8). Callers: Ai_Update_VehicleDriver (v0 = car+0x3c, v1 = cfg+200, max = zone+0x44; stores zone+0x44 - result at +0xf4 and feeds the result as the distance key of Ai_TestTable_LookupByDistanceSpeed) and Ai_Lookahead_AdvancePhase.
